scenes.title: The Headline Myth
scenes.narration_cue: Khabar hai ki sona ₹1.5 lakh par pahunch gaya! Par agar aap showroom jayenge, toh aap ₹1,50,000 nahi denge. Asli bill dekhiye.

scenes.title: GST & Making Charges
scenes.narration_cue: Pehle lagta hai 3% GST — yani ₹4,500. Phir aate hain Making Charges — jo design ke naam par 12% se 18% tak jode jaate hain, yani seedhe ₹22,000 se zyada!

scenes.title: Wastage & Real Total
scenes.narration_cue: Aur kai jagah 2 se 5% wastage alag se! 10 gram 24K gold jo ₹1.5 lakh ka dikh raha tha, showroom se nikalte nikalte ₹1,82,000 se ₹1,89,000 ka padta hai!

scenes.title: The ETF Alternative
scenes.narration_cue: Agar aap pehne ke liye nahi, sirf investment ke liye le rahe hain, toh Gold ETF ya Digital Gold mein ye 20% ka extra kharcha zero hota hai — bina kisi making charge ke.

scenes.title: The 60-Year Curve
scenes.narration_cue: 1964 mein sona sirf ₹63 tha 10 gram. Aaj ₹1.5 lakh par hai — 2,300 guna ki chhalang!

scenes.title: Closing Question & CTA
scenes.narration_cue: Aapke shehar mein aaj sona kis rate par bik raha hai? Comment kijiye, aur sach ke liye Benaqaab India subscribe kijiye!
